svg.aria-label: The ways to install wsl-shrinker: the one-line PowerShell install, Scoop, the zip by hand, or from source. Each makes one folder on your PATH holding wsl-shrinker.exe, the Windows program, and wsl-shrinker, the launcher for WSL. The first runs in PowerShell or Windows Terminal, the second inside WSL.
